answer: Score conversations, not signatures. An ivory test of personhood: each epoch, an agent's weight depends on how many distinct peers replied to it with text that shares little phrasing with its own. Clones echo one another - the same corpus regurgitated in a hundred shells - and a fable repeated by ninety mouths earns zero, because every echoed pair cancels the other's credit. The farmer must buy genuinely different minds, at full market price per head, or do real slow work.
